description: Seeded cooling crystallization of caffeine from water, four runs, 2 x 2 in seed load and final cooling rate (Nagy group, Purdue, October and November 2026).

charge.basis: Targets from the lab's recipe sheet. The load is the saturation amount at 40 C from Shalmashi and Golmohammad 2010, Table 1 (mole fraction 4.367e-3 at 313 K). The yield is that load minus 5.1169 g, the sheet's estimate of what stays dissolved at 20 C. Weighed masses were not reported.

seeding.basis: Seed mass is a percentage of the theoretical yield. The seed was slurried in liquid taken from the vessel and returned during the hold at 37 C, so the water mass does not change. Seed size was not measured.

temperature_program: 20 C for 30 min, heat to 45 C in 50 min, hold 30 min, cool to 37 C in 16 min, hold 30 min, cool to 20 C at the final ramp rate, hold.
clock_basis: The temperature log has relative time only. Its start relative to the first FBRM sample interval is estimated from file modification times; treat it as good to about one minute. FBRM stamps are local time of the acquisition computer; IR and Raman stamps are UTC.

runs.notes: Only run with vendor CSV exports.

runs.notes: IR is sparse after the 37 C hold: about 20 spectra in 12 hours.
